in_sanskrit.name: Harish
in_sanskrit.meaning: God Hari (Vishnu) is the giver (of boons)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Harau shishatam karma kritam (Hari, the giver of boons, does all actions)

in_marathi.name: Harisingh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Hari's Lion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harisingh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harisingh is a Sanskrit name that translates to 'Lord Hari's Lion'. This name is derived from the combination of 'Hari' (God Vishnu) and 'Singh' (lion). In Hindu mythology, lions are considered the vehicles of various deities, symbolizing power, courage, and royalty.
